# Fixed C2 completed artifact replay

[`completed_c2.run_fixed_c2_receipt`](completed_c2.py) is a mechanism-only replay of the fixed C2 producer artifact from an already resolved completed run. It accepts the typed result of [`completed_run.resolve_completed_run`](completed-run-README.md), the parsed output of [`completed_validation.inspect_completed_run`](completed-validation-README.md), the exact staged-artifact directory, the original clean source checkout, and a fresh private staging directory. Its single absolute monotonic deadline is supplied by the caller; the function does not renew it.

The function selects exactly `issue779-csharp-checkpoint2-{run_id}-{run_attempt}` from the fixed completed artifact inventory. It rejects extra or missing staged files, then compares artifact ID, byte size, SHA-256, staged filename, and ZIP member/compression projection before extraction. The declared member sizes must already fit the original C2 retention limits before any extracted node is created. The captured `source.json` must match the resolved run's head, source tree, and capture digest. The original source tree must be clean and exactly match that capture. Only after current source-owned `binding.verify_source` checks the checkout does the replay load capture-hashed `measurement_chain.py`, `producer_roots.py`, `measurement.py`, `measurement_arguments.py`, `run-native.py`, and `staging.py` from that checkout.

The replay calls the original fixed `measurement_chain.c2` and `producer_roots.native` validators. These check the C2 measurement binding, report and package-smoke chain, seven-case native receipt, case order, expected exits, cleanup/quarantine facts, and fixed-false native/Trusted claims. It also calls the capture-verified [`package_smoke_evidence.validate`](../issue779-checkpoint4/package_smoke_evidence.py) on the exact 29 curated leaves, binding all 23 command logs and the planning outputs to the byte-identical top-level smoke receipt. The replay binds all seven canonical per-case receipt files and paired owner stdout/stderr files to their original receipt hashes. It invokes the original C2 `read_output_observation` parser and requires both registered stream pairs to report actual stdout and stderr EOF. The quota case retains its original `QuotaExceeded` semantics; the other six cases must retain `None` failure semantics. The artifact-mutation case uses the original parser for the retained-byte mutation and authentic zero-byte read rejection.

This check preserves the existing producer's 128-file and 32 MiB retention limits. It only reads extracted files; it does not call the producer's `check-retention.py`, which chmods nodes. Extraction uses the existing C1 no-follow, descriptor-relative staging and cleanup utilities. Cleanup removes only invocation-owned nodes whose identities still match. A substitution or failed cleanup rejects the operation; a callback error remains primary. The original absolute deadline is checked again after cleanup.

## API shape and choices

`run_fixed_c2_receipt(stage, inventory, stage_directory, source_root, staging, *, deadline)` returns an immutable `C2ReceiptProjection`. The projection contains the exact artifact and source/run bindings, seven receipt/log digests, native receipt and inventory digests, and literal false native-acceptance and Trusted-eligibility fields. It is data only; it must never be passed to runtime admission, an accepted-proof registry, or a coverage gate.

The internal `replay_extracted_c2(source_root, artifact_root, source_raw, *, head, source_tree, run_id, run_attempt, artifact_name, artifact_sha256, deadline)` helper supports a bounded mechanism replay when an independently verified provider harness already extracted the exact original C2 archive. Its caller owns extraction and must independently bind archive name, provider metadata, size and SHA-256 before calling. The helper checks the exact run-bound artifact name and all source/callback semantics; it does not authenticate a provider response by itself.

Use the public wrapper after the fixed completed-run resolver and archive projector have produced their typed outputs. Use the internal helper only for an isolated original-artifact mechanism replay, such as a reviewed harness that has independently verified the immutable provider artifact. Do not feed caller-selected producer or parser callbacks. The source-owned code fixes both the producer and parser.

## Limits and non-claims

The C2 ZIP uses the existing completed-run per-artifact and total archive ceilings, the shared ZIP parser's member and path restrictions, a 64 MiB extracted-member cap, a 512 MiB expanded-data cap, maximum path depth 64, and the original retention limit of 128 files/32 MiB. The public wrapper requires the original canonical source checkout because the C2 measurement callbacks verify source-bound paths. No native work is rerun.

The return value proves only that the original C2 data callbacks ran against the retained C2 producer artifact and that its seven fixed case receipts and paired streams match. It does not by itself close the C2 measured-segment lineage, the external C4 rollback predecessor, C1/C3/C4 callbacks, all completed-run roles, solution or Codecov gates, protected downstream qualification, or human acceptance. In particular, `measurement_chain.c2` checking its C2 predecessor inputs is not a claim that the other run artifacts or the overall gate passed. See the [57-group plan](../../docs/plans/issue-779-evidencehost-test-plan.md) for the remaining independent evidence requirements.

The tests include a full synthetic provider-stage wrapper path that uses the actual completed-run projection, bounded ZIP parser, private extraction, and cleanup while mocking only the original callback boundary. Separate optional original-artifact tests replay run `40483696166`, verify its seven original EOF observations, and reject a changed case receipt or removed EOF fact. A successful original-artifact replay is only a mechanism check and is not full qualification or gate evidence.
